== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Perfected]] are a highly competent and formidable group of [[Karoshan|Karoshans]] who serve as a significant threat within the galaxy. They are created through a costly and dangerous process involving magical rituals, alchemical reagents, and the sacrifice of hundreds or even thousands of [[Karoshan|Karoshans]]. This method involves harvesting genetics to use as templates for new members, a process with a low survival rate. As a result, they are viewed by some as abominations. Physically, the [[Perfected]] are slimmer than natural [[Karoshan|Karoshans]] but possess more effective musculature, making them faster and stronger. They often exhibit specialized traits, such as long reptilian tails or sharper teeth, and possess capabilities equal to dozens of standard [[Karoshan|Karoshans]]. In combat, they are equipped with advanced technology and magic, including [[Aethertech]] personal shields and force-blades. They hold various specialized roles, such as duelists, marksmen, snipers, and mages. Their ambitions involve galactic rule and the assertion of [[Karoshan]] superiority. Currently, they are known to operate out of research facilities and outposts, where they have been observed investigating the biology of [[Subspace]] inhabitants to further their own self-improvement and attempting to create a [[Karoshan]] [[Iron King]]. Their military presence includes significant assets like the dreadnought [[Dragon’s Edge|Dragon's Edge]].}}
